transcript.text: Everyday I get sent 5, 10, 20 videos of
people making content about me sucking.
And you have to be able to understand
the dichotomy that will force hatred.
So, let me explain. If I say anything
about justice, there's going to be a
clip. And so then people will take the
natural opposite extreme, which is that
what you're saying, I should never have
mercy. It's like, no, of course not. But
the problem is that if you try and cater
to everyone, you will cater to no one.
Because all of these exist on
continuums. They are dichotomies to be
managed, not problems to be solved. Do
you need justice at some points in life
and mercy in others? Absolutely. But
because of the nature of short form, and
because people are going to consume six
seconds of what you say, you have to
assume that they are never going to
understand you. And in hoping that
everyone loves you in making content,
what you'll end up doing is demanding
that a universe understand you
completely in a context that it never
will. I just shared what works for me.

to you. And to every person who makes
videos about disagreeing with me, please
do. And Voltaire famously said, "I

it."
